Messages.Author: guntherbl
Messages.Body:
If I play Horrid Reality at Superior, then use Dragon Breath Rounds on
the weapon I summoned, what happens at the end of combat: is the weapon
burned or is it shuffled back into my library?

If I summon an unique weapon (Ivory bow) with H.R. does it contest an
Ivory Bow already in play? I think not, by analogy with the vampire
summoned with an Illusion of the Kindred but the card does not specify,
whereas Illusion card does.

Thank you.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
guntherbl <gunt...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> If I play Horrid Reality at Superior, then use Dragon Breath Rounds on
> the weapon I summoned, what happens at the end of combat: is the
> weapon burned or is it shuffled back into my library?

From the online rulings:

* If the weapon gained is not in play (burned by Destroy Equipment,
e.g.) by the end of combat, do not burn it (or do not shuffle it
into your library, if superior). [TOM 12-DEC-1995]

> If I summon an unique weapon (Ivory bow) with H.R. does it contest an
> Ivory Bow already in play? I think not, by analogy with the vampire
> summoned with an Illusion of the Kindred but the card does not
> specify, whereas Illusion card does.

It is contested. The illusionary copy is burned at the end of the
combat and the other copy (if it is the only other copy) is
recontrolled at the appropriate untap phase [TOM 12-DEC-95]

They cannot be used to strike, no.
